newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca's Amistar approved for UK cereals.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca's Amistar approved for UK cereals.

text.p: Britain's Zeneca Group Plc said on Wednesday a new fungicide, Amistar, had been approved by the Pesticides Safety Directorate for use on cereal crops in the UK.
Amistar, derived from naturally-occurring fungicides found in woodland mushrooms, is active against four major groups of fungal diseases that attack crops, Zeneca said in a statement.
In the past year, Amistar has received registrations for crops in some 14 countries, including cereals in Europe, bananas in Central America, and turfgrass in the U.S.
"We are delighted to have received this registration in time to let us conduct farm scale field testing this season, in preparation for a full-scale launch in 1998," Zeneca said in a statement.
